output.narrative: The child is actively exploring storytelling and recalling experiences in the classroom. In July, the child named familiar characters in a picture book and answered simple questions about the story. By August, the child used a picture prompt to help share a short account of a picnic with friends. During a small-group activity in October, the child retold the beginning and middle of a familiar story, and with a gentle question from a teacher, was able to explain the ending. The child also contributes ideas to group discussions when provided with a little extra prompting.

这个学期，孩子在中文表达上表现得越来越积极。在阅读活动中，孩子非常喜欢动物和自然主题的图书，常通过观察图片理解故事内容，并能准确说出熟悉的动物名称。在小组分享与角色扮演时，孩子愿意主动用短句介绍自己的作品或表达需求，如“我要苹果”等。当遇到不熟悉的词汇时，孩子会灵活运用手势辅助，或在停顿整理语言后向教师求助。在教师提供简短引导或给予等待时间时，孩子能更从容地通过短句描述图片内容或分享自己的想法，并在回答简单追问时尝试加入颜色和动作等细节。

During this semester, the child has explored several mathematical concepts through hands-on play. When counting, the child uses one-to-one pointing effectively, often arranging items in a line to ensure an accurate count up to ten, and sometimes requires a reminder to move scattered objects before counting. The child has demonstrated an understanding of patterns, copying repeating patterns and creating their own for others, while also noticing when a sequence is incorrect. In addition, the child has sorted objects by colour, identified shapes like circles, squares, and triangles, and successfully used terms such as "more" and "fewer" to compare groups. While working with numbers, the child has matched numerals to quantities and explored addition by adding one more to a group and counting the total.

The child is engaging with peers in various collaborative activities, such as building and drawing. In July, with some teacher support to introduce the task, the child joined a paired building activity. Throughout the semester, the child has demonstrated social problem-solving skills; for instance, in August, the child asked a classmate for a turn with a toy truck and waited after a reminder. By October, the child was initiating play by inviting a friend to draw and offering to share crayons. When a conflict arose over a specific colour, the child asked the teacher for help to resolve it. A brief reminder of the next step continues to be helpful during transitions.

The child has been engaging with stories and sharing experiences in various ways this semester. In July, the child identified familiar characters and answered simple questions while looking through picture books. Throughout the semester, the child demonstrated a growing ability to share personal accounts and retell narratives; for example, the child used a picture prompt in August to recall the sequence of a picnic with friends, and in October, the child retold the beginning and middle portions of a familiar story. When discussing story endings or sharing ideas during group time, the child has used prompting from educators to help express these thoughts.

本学期，孩子在语言表达方面展现了积极的探索精神。在阅读角，孩子喜欢选择动物与自然主题的图画书，并能通过观察图片中的小猫、小狗等角色来理解故事内容。随着学期的深入，孩子在小组活动中表现得越来越愿意开口表达，在7月能指出图片中的角色，到了9月和10月，已能尝试用“我要苹果”这样的短句提出需求，甚至会用颜色和动作等细节来介绍自己喜欢的动物。在表达遇到困难或不熟悉词汇时，孩子会灵活运用手势或向老师求助。当面对需要描述图片顺序或分享画作的任务时，孩子能够说出两三个短句，并在老师的适当引导和等待下，进一步梳理想法并组织语言，在熟悉的同伴面前自信地进行分享。

The child has explored various mathematical concepts this semester, demonstrating growing skills in counting and pattern recognition. During the term, the child practiced one-to-one counting, including counting groups up to ten while pretend shopping, and found it helpful to arrange objects in a line when counting scattered items. In our small-group games, the child successfully compared groups using the terms more and fewer, and sorted buttons by color, clearly explaining the logic behind each pile. The child also enjoyed creating and extending two-color patterns, often noticing when a piece was out of sequence. Furthermore, the child has been investigating shapes and simple addition, such as adding one more to a group of five and checking the total by counting all the objects.

The child frequently engages in collaborative activities, such as building and drawing with peers. In July, the child joined a paired building task after a teacher introduction, and by October, was seen initiating play by inviting a friend to draw and offering to share crayons. The child is learning to navigate social interactions, often waiting for a turn with a toy truck after a reminder, or asking for help from an educator when conflicts arise, such as when both children wanted the same crayon. Brief reminders of the next step continue to be helpful for the child during transitions between activities.

The child is engaging with stories and sharing ideas in several ways. In July, the child named familiar characters in a picture book and answered simple questions about them. By August, the child used a picture prompt to share a personal account of a picnic with friends. This engagement with storytelling continued into October, when the child retold the beginning and middle of a familiar story in a small group, requiring a question from the teacher to explain the ending. Throughout the term, the child has also contributed ideas during group time with the support of a little prompting.

孩子在学校展现了对动物和自然主题图画书的浓厚兴趣，图片内容不仅帮助孩子理解故事，也为表达提供了线索。从7月起，孩子在阅读时能指认动物名称，并逐步发展到在9月和10月的小组分享中，尝试用两三个短句介绍自己的画作或喜欢的动物，甚至能加入颜色和动作等细节。在日常互动中，孩子乐于在熟悉的小组环境中表达想法，遇到不熟悉的词汇时，会灵活运用手势或向教师求助。当面对较长的表达或描述图片联系时，孩子有时需要教师提供简短的问题引导或整理思路。我们通过给予等待时间和适当提示，支持孩子继续尝试用中文自然地进行交流。

The child has been actively exploring mathematical concepts through play this semester. When counting, the child uses one-to-one pointing, showing consistent accuracy when arranging objects in a line, such as counting eight shells or groups of ten during pretend play. The child also enjoys sorting and patterns, demonstrating the ability to copy, extend, and check repeating sequences like red-blue patterns. In early number work, the child has used counters to compare groups using the terms more and fewer, and explored adding one more to a group of five. While the child is developing these counting strategies, they find it helpful to arrange scattered objects into lines to support their counting accuracy.

The child has been engaging thoughtfully with peers in shared activities throughout the semester. In July, with some initial guidance, the child joined a paired building task. By August, the child demonstrated patience by asking a classmate for a turn with a toy truck and waiting while they finished, following a reminder. During an October drawing session, the child showed initiative by inviting a friend to join and offering to share crayons. When a disagreement arose over a specific colour, the child sought assistance to resolve it. The child enjoys collaborating during building and drawing projects, and continues to benefit from brief reminders to help navigate transitions between activities.
